verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              प्रागेव वसुदेवस्तु व्रजे शुश्राव रोहिणीम्। प्रजातां पुत्रमेवाग्रे चन्द्रात्कान्ततराननम्॥१॥
स नन्दगोपं त्वरितः प्रोवाच शुभया गिरा। गच्छानया सहैव त्वं व्रजमेव यशोदया॥२॥
verses.english: There emerged a son to this अन्ग prajApati, named वेन, who is a selfmade philistine in the matters of dharma... this king वेन took birth from the daughter of Death, namely lady सुनीथ, and prajApati anga...
verses.bhavadeepa: अथास्मिन्पञ्चमेऽध्याये वसुदेवोपदेशतः। सकुटुम्बस्य नन्दस्य व्रजे गमनमीर्यते॥१॥ प्रागेव प्रसवात्पूर्वमेव व्रजे प्रेषितामिति शेषः॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तौ दारकौ गत्वा जातकर्मादिभिर्गुणैः। योजयित्वा व्रजे तात संवर्धय यथासुखम्॥३॥
verses.english: "If I have a fancy, I will burn the earth, or deluge it in waters... or, immobilize earth and heaven... you need not treat it cavalierly..." So said vena to sages.
verses.bhavadeepa: नन्दगोपं सपुत्रस्त्रीकं मथुरां प्रति करं प्रदातुमागतामित्यर्थात भागवताच्च गम्यते॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: रौहिणेयं च पुत्रं मे परिरक्ष शिशुं व्रजे। अहं वाच्यो भविष्यामि पितृपक्षेषु पुत्रिणाम्॥४॥
verses.english: Relegating his own dharma rearwards king वेन indulged in acquisitiveness and tight-fistedness, owing to his deriving adversarial qualities of his maternal grandfather, namely the Death, because वेन is the son of the daughter of Timegod, namely यम...
verses.bhavadeepa: गुणैर्जातकर्मादिसंस्कारैर्लिप्याद्यभ्यासैश्च॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: योऽहमेकस्य पुत्रस्य न पश्यामि शिशोर्मुखम्। ह्रियते हि बलात्प्रज्ञा प्राज्ञस्यापि ततो मम॥५॥
verses.english: On listening to various arguments of Mother Earth in the form of cow, that highminded pR^ithu restrained his anger and spoke to her in this way.

verses.sanskrit: अस्माद्धि मे भयं कंसान्निर्घृणाद्वै शिशोर्वधे। तद्यथा रौहिणेयं त्वं नन्दगोपं ममात्मजम्॥६॥
verses.english: "Oh, vena, no doubt, you have emerged in this dynasty of prajApati-s after the demise of atri, and you promised to rule the people righteously... and we for ourselves have entered a ritual vow that lasts for many long years... so, please do not embark on this Endeavour of altering the existing practice of vedic rituals aimed at gods... please do not change the age-old practice... " So said sages to king vena.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रज्ञा दैवाधीनमिदमिति धीः ह्रियते भयादिनेति शेषः॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: गोपायसि यथा तात तत्त्वान्वेषी तथा कुरु। विघ्ना हि बहवो लोके बालानुत्त्रासयन्ति हि॥७॥
verses.english: Laughing at those great sages who are speaking thus, then the evil-minded vena spoke this to them, without knowing the meaning and fatality contained in the saying of sages.

verses.sanskrit: स च पुत्रो मम ज्यायान्कनीयांश्च तवाप्ययम्। उभावपि समं नाम्ना निरीक्षस्व यथासुखम्॥८॥
verses.english: From then onwards, oh, janamejaya, whenever such praises of legitimization are to be heard, or blessings needed to be showered, then the eulogies sUtA-s and mAgadhA-s have come into vogue.
verses.bhavadeepa: तत्त्वान्वेषी यथावदालोचयन्। बालद्रोहिणां स्वरूपमिति शेषः॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: वर्धमानावुभावेतौ समानवयसौ यथा। शोभेतां गोव्रजे तस्मिन्नन्दगोप तथा कुरु॥९॥
verses.english: "For all the living beings, as a matter of fact, for dharma itself I am the provenance... but, you sages are fatuous to know this owing to your half-wittedness...
verses.bhavadeepa: नाम्ना नामार्थेन निरीक्षस्व यथा कृष्णस्तव चित्तं कर्षति स्नेहातिशयाद्वशीकरोति तथा सङ्कर्षणोऽपि त्वां रमयत्वित्यर्थः॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: बाल्ये केलिकिलः सर्वो बाल्ये मुह्यति मानवः। बाल्ये चण्डतमः सर्वस्तत्र यत्नपरो भव॥१०॥
verses.english: "If I have a fancy, I will burn the earth, or deluge it in waters... or, immobilize earth and heaven... you need not treat it cavalierly..." So said vena to sages.

verses.sanskrit: न च वृन्दावने कार्यो गवां घोषः कथञ्चन। भेतव्यं तत्र वसतः केशिनः पापदर्शिनः॥११॥
verses.english: And you may know that others called तुषारा-स्, तुम्बुरा-s, who took delight in अधर्म and whose abode is vindhya range, have also emerged as the posterity of vena.
verses.bhavadeepa: केलिकिलः स्वेच्छाविहारी॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: सरीसृपेभ्यः कीटेभ्यः शकुनिभ्यस्तथैव च। गोष्ठेषु गोभ्यो वत्सेभ्यो रक्ष्यौ ते द्वाविमौ शिशू॥१२॥
verses.english: While the great sages are giving friction to the thighs of that king vena, then there emerged a blackish stocky male dwarf.
verses.bhavadeepa: घोषो गोपग्रामः॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: नन्दगोप गता रात्रिः शीघ्रयानो व्रजाशुगः। इमे त्वां व्याहरन्तीव पक्षिणः सव्यदक्षिणम्॥१३॥
verses.english: "For all the living beings, as a matter of fact, for dharma itself I am the provenance... but, you sages are fatuous to know this owing to your half-wittedness...

verses.sanskrit: रहस्यं वसुदेवेन सोऽनुज्ञातो महात्मना। यानं यशोदया सार्धमारुरोह मुदान्वितः॥१४॥
verses.english: And that dwarifish person has become the initiator of the line of निषादा-s, the putative tribals, and he begot highly courageous offspring, just emerged out of the blemish of vena's enormity.

verses.sanskrit: कुमारस्कन्धवाह्यायां शिबिकायां समाहितः। संवेशयामास शिशुं शयनीयं महामतिः॥१५॥
verses.english: And you may know that others called तुषारा-स्, तुम्बुरा-s, who took delight in अधर्म and whose abode is vindhya range, have also emerged as the posterity of vena.

verses.sanskrit: जगाम च विविक्तेन शीतलानिलसर्पिणा। बहूदकेन मार्गेण यमुनातीरगामिना॥१६॥
verses.english: Then those highminded sages still becoming furious again gave friction to the right hand of vena as if it is a stick of अरणि, wooden sticks used to generate ritual fire.
verses.bhavadeepa: शिबिकायाम् आन्दोलिकायां शिबिकायां सुखरूपायामिति प्राञ्चः। मृदुतूलिकायामिति तस्यार्थः कशिपुशब्दसादृश्यात्॥१५॥

verses.sanskrit: स ददर्श शुभे देशे गोवर्धनसमीपगे। यमुनातीरसम्बद्धशीतमारुतसेवितम्॥१७॥
verses.english: The, pR^ithu who is interested in the welfare of people took his bow and ran after Mother Earth.
verses.bhavadeepa: बहूदकत्वात् शीतलोऽनिलः सर्पत्यस्मिन् तेन शीतलानिलसर्पिणा॥१६॥

verses.sanskrit: विरुतश्वापदै रम्यं लतावल्लीमहाद्रुमम्। गोभिस्तृणविलग्नाभिः स्यन्दन्तीभिरलङ्कृतम्॥१८॥
verses.english: Then that dwarf stood aside with folded palms as he is panicked, and seeing him whose eyes are blank and fidgety, sage अत्रि said to him, "sit back..."
verses.bhavadeepa: स ददर्श गोव्रजमिति पञ्चदशगतेनान्वयः॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: समप्रचारं च गवां समतीर्थजलाशयम्। वृषाणां स्कन्धघातैश्च विषाणोद्घृष्टपादपम्॥१९॥
verses.english: And that dwarifish person has become the initiator of the line of निषादा-s, the putative tribals, and he begot highly courageous offspring, just emerged out of the blemish of vena's enormity.
verses.bhavadeepa: विशिष्टं रुतं येषां तैः श्वापदैर्विरुतश्वापदैः लता भुवि प्रसर्पन्त्यः कूष्माण्ड्यादयो वल्लयः आरोहणसापेक्षा द्राक्षादयः तत्सहिता महान्तो द्रुमा यस्मिन्। स्यन्दन्तीभिः प्रस्रवन्तीभिः॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: भासामिषादानुसृतैः श्येनैश्चामिषगृध्नुभिः। सृगालमृगसिंहैश्च वसामेदाशिभिर्वृतम्॥२०॥
verses.english: As soon as he got a perfect and worthy son, namely pR^ithu, then king vena is rescued from falling into a hell called पुन्नाम-नररक, to where sonless fathers are destined, and went to heaven.
verses.bhavadeepa: समानि तीर्थानि जलावतरणमार्गा येषु तादृशा जलाशया यत्र॥१९॥

verses.sanskrit: शार्दूलशब्दाभिरुतं नानापक्षिसमाकुलम्। स्वादुवृक्षफलं रम्यं पर्याप्ततृणवीरुधम्॥२१॥
verses.english: When all the oceans and rivers have fetched and readied gems and waters from all over to anoint pR^ithu as emperor, then brahma came there along with sages, gods, and all sessile and mobile beings, and anointed that vena's son pR^ithu as the king of kings to administer kingship.
verses.bhavadeepa: भासाः गृध्राः तदनुसृतैः श्येनैः। आमिषादा वनबिडालादयस्तदनुसृतैस्ततोऽधिकबलैः सृगालादिभिश्च। वृतम्। मृगश्चित्रव्याघ्रः॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: गोव्रजं गोरुतं रम्यं गोपनारीभिरावृतम्। हम्भारवैश्च वत्सानां सर्वतः कृतनिःस्वनम्॥२२॥
verses.english: From that right hand of vena there emerged the highly resplendent पृथु, where his physique blazed like the blaze of ritual fire.

verses.sanskrit: शकटावर्तविपुलं कण्टकीवाटसङ्कुलम्। पर्यन्तेष्वावृतं वन्यैर्बृहद्भिः पतितैर्द्रुमैः॥२३॥
verses.english: That highly renowned pR^ithu emerged with bow and armour, where his bow called आजगव is highly twanging, and the armour is highly lustrous, and the divine arrows are highly protective.
verses.bhavadeepa: हम्भारवैर्गोशब्दैः॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: वत्सानां रोपितः कीलैर्दामभिश्च विभूषितम्। करीषाकीर्णवसुधं कटच्छन्नकुटीमठम्॥२४॥
verses.english: Oh, king janamejaya, when pR^ithu took birth all the beings are highly rejoiced and came rushing towards him... and in the meanwhile king vena went to heaven.
verses.bhavadeepa: वाटो वृत्तिस्थानं कण्टकपरिधिः। “वाटो मार्गवृतिस्थाने” इति मेदिनी॥२३॥

verses.sanskrit: क्षेम्यप्रचारबहुलं हृष्टपुष्टजनावृतम्। दामनीपाशबहुलं गर्गरोद्गारनिःस्वनम्॥२५॥
verses.english: Sages said to those eulogists, "sing the glory of his future acts..." and pR^ithu's future acts remained just as sung by those two eulogists. The sages said this about pR^ithu's future as below:
verses.bhavadeepa: करीषं शुष्कगोमयचूर्णम्॥२४॥

verses.sanskrit: तक्रानिःस्रावमलिनं दधिमण्डार्द्रमृत्तिकम्। मन्थानवलयोद्गारैर्गोपीनां जनितस्वनम्॥२६॥
verses.english: During this time when an auspicious vedic ritual aiming at brahma is being conducted, there arose highminded सूत, at the time of सूति, i.e., during the time when सोम creeper is pressed for juice - सोम अभिषव काले; on the day of सौति i.e., a nominated day for pressing soma juice during the period of vedic ritual.
verses.bhavadeepa: क्षेम्या लब्धलक्षणार्हाः भटास्तत्प्रचारेण बहुलं समृद्धिमत्। दामिनी स्थूणद्वयाक्रान्तप्रान्ता स्थूलरज्जुः यस्यां दामान्यासज्यन्ते। गर्गरो मन्थनकुम्भः। “गर्गरो मीनभेदे स्यान्मन्थन्यामपि गर्गरी।” इति विश्वः॥२५॥

verses.sanskrit: काकपक्षधरैर्बालैर्गोपालक्रीडनाकुलम्। सार्गलद्वारगोवाटं मध्ये गोस्थानसङ्कुलम्॥२७॥
verses.english: Sages said to those eulogists, "sing the glory of his future acts..." and pR^ithu's future acts remained just as sung by those two eulogists. The sages said this about pR^ithu's future as below:
verses.bhavadeepa: तक्रेत्यन्तं गोरसाधिक्यमुक्तम्। निःस्रवो रेचनप्रणालिका तद्देशे शैवालेन मलिनं मण्डम् उपर्यागतः सारः॥२६॥

verses.sanskrit: सर्पिषा पच्यमानेन सुरभीकृतमारुतम्। नीलपीताम्बराभिश्च तरुणीभिरलङ्कृतम्॥२८॥
verses.english: "This king would be truthful to his word, bountiful by his will, forthright and forbearing, prosperous and victorious, conqueror as well as chastener of evildoers, diligent and scrupulous, benignant and amicable, honoured and honouring, vedic ritualist and upholder of brahma, an epitome of truth itself, calm and collective, and that king will always be engaged in his kingly activities..." So said sages to eulogists foreseeing the future of pR^ithu.
verses.bhavadeepa: गोपाः क्रीडन्त्यस्मिन्निति क्रीडास्थानम् आखाडा इति भाषाप्रसिद्धम्॥२७॥

verses.sanskrit: वन्यपुष्पावतंसाभिर्गोपकन्याभिरावृतम्। शिरोभिर्धृतकुम्भभिर्बद्धैरग्रस्तनाम्बरैः॥२९॥
verses.english: From then onwards, oh, janamejaya, whenever such praises of legitimization are to be heard, or blessings needed to be showered, then the eulogies sUtA-s and mAgadhA-s have come into vogue.

verses.sanskrit: यमुनातीरमार्गेण जलहारीभिरावृतम्। स तत्र प्रविशन्हृष्टो गोव्रजं गोपनादितम्॥३०॥
verses.english: And pR^ithu pleased with their eulogies bequeathed the province called अनूप to eulogist sUta, and a province called मागध to eulogist mAgadha.
verses.bhavadeepa: अग्रस्तनाम्बैरः काञ्चोली इति भाषाप्रसिद्धैः कञ्चुकैरुपलक्षिताः॥२९॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्युद्गतो गोपवृद्धैः स्त्रीभिर्वृद्धाभिरेव च। निवेशं रोचयामास परिवर्ते सुखाश्रये॥३१॥
verses.english: And pR^ithu pleased with their eulogies bequeathed the province called अनूप to eulogist sUta, and a province called मागध to eulogist mAgadha.

verses.sanskrit: सा यत्र रोहिणी देवी वसुदेवसुखावहा। तत्र तं बालसूर्याभं कृष्णं गूढं न्यवेशयत्॥३२॥
verses.english: On observing pR^ithu, the great sages have said to the people, "this king will allocate respective occupations to you all..." and then according to the saying of the sages, people rushed to pR^ithu and said, "be pleased to allocate our duties and functions ..."
verses.bhavadeepa: परिवर्ते शकटादिप्रकारे सुखकरे आश्रयस्थाने॥३१॥
